behaviors.open-percentage-calculator: The new Percentage calculator appears in the Math tools and opens at /percentage-calculator.
behaviors.calculate-percent-of-value: Entering a percentage and a value shows the calculated portion, such as 123% of 456 = 560.88.
behaviors.calculate-value-as-percent: Entering two values shows what percent the first is of the second.
behaviors.calculate-percentage-increase: Entering a lower From value and a higher To value shows the percentage increase.
behaviors.calculate-percentage-decrease: Entering a higher From value and a lower To value shows a negative percentage change.
behaviors.show-empty-incomplete-result: A calculator’s result stays blank until both of its inputs are filled.

history.notes: The tour clicks the calculator link from the home listing and uses the component’s data-test-id attributes to distinguish the three input groups. The Math category placement follows the supplied tool registry.
